o.text:
Morphologically dolmaq (“to be full”) + -dur.
Cognate with Kazakh толтыру (toltıruw, “to fill”), Turkish doldurmak (“to fill”), Uzbek to'ldirmoq (“to fill”), Kyrgyz толтуруу (tolturuu, “to fill”).
From Arabic إِقَامَة (ʔiqāma). Doublet of iqamə.
